question.text: Per the current NISM V-A workbook, how many sub-categories are now permitted under Equity Schemes by SEBI (including Flexi-Cap)?

explanation.text: The Logic: The current NISM V-A workbook (pp.48–50) states that Equity Schemes have 11 sub-categories, with Flexi-Cap added as the 11th: Multi Cap, Large Cap, Large & Mid Cap, Mid Cap, Small Cap, Dividend Yield, Value/Contra, Focused, Sectoral/Thematic, ELSS, and Flexi-Cap. The Trap: The original 2017 SEBI categorization circular had 10 equity sub-categories; "10" reflects that older list rather than the current workbook. 16 is the Debt count, not Equity. Cross-Exam Context: NISM V-A and V-B both test the current 11-sub-category list; the rule limiting an AMC to one scheme per sub-category (with limited exceptions) remains.
